record.question: Phototherapy is most effective when:
options: Lights are placed >60 cm from the baby
Maximum body surface area is exposed
Applying oil to the skin as it increases absorption
record.explanation: Answer C: Maximum body surface area is exposed. Phototherapy works best when the maximum safe skin surface area is exposed to the light source, with eye protection and temperature monitoring. Source/context note: Distance and intensity follow device-specific guidance; protect eyes and monitor the infant. Reference: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/hyperbilirubinemia/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
